description:
Modify the 'Sample House' project in DreamPlan Home Design Software to create an open-concept layout.

Your specific goals are:
1. Load the 'Sample House' project (usually accessible from the start screen or samples folder).
2. Switch to the 2D Blueprint view to clearly see the layout.
3. Identify and DELETE the interior wall that separates the Kitchen from the Dining/Living area.
4. Ensure no other walls are deleted (exterior walls must remain intact).
5. Save the modified project as 'OpenConcept' (OpenConcept.dp or OpenConcept.ddp) in the default Documents/Projects folder.
